verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a SaaS email product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only an official MCP server for connecting AI assistants. That belongs to a separate story and is not an SDK. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, and no evidence mentions any official SDK or client library.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
